output: For each source-pair/demand incidence (p,d) in one handoff pattern, choose its own declared simple route r_(p,d) in sameTokenRoutingSupport token p. The exact relation W={(p,e):e lies on at least one of p's routes} satisfies |W|=Σ_p w_p=Σ_e n_P(e). Its restriction M to physical assigned fan edges B satisfies |M|=Σ_p z_p=Σ_(e∈B) m_P(e), retaining uncovered P_0={p:z_p=0}. Pair-indexed component visits V satisfy |V|=Σ_p v_p=Σ_C m_C(C). The pair-demand boundary crossing identity and endpoint parity hold for every (p,d,C). Shared star demands may have different routes in different pairs. No source coverage, source multiplicity cap, or rank charge follows.
